title: Catalyst and solvent-free solid–solid melt synthesis of multi-colour emissive 2-functionalized quinoxaline-based fluorophores
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21676-21692
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01059H, Paper
Open Access

Sai Teja Talari, Rama Mohana Reddy Sirigireddy, Siva Dakshayani Vadanapalli, Mohan Das Dasappa, Sultana Shaik, Venkatramu Vemula, Eethamukkala Ubba, Ramamohana Reddy Maddike, Haranath Divi, Chinna Gangi Reddy Nallagondu
A rapid, highly efficient and scalable solid–solid melt reaction (SSMR) strategy has been developed for synthesizing multi colour-emissive and hole-transporting quinoxaline-based small organic fluorophores under solvent- and catalyst-free conditions.
